requirements.why: [recall pass] Table 4 geometric-visibility minimum for the R2 rear position lamp.

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 60 cd (6.0∙10^1 cd).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement on the axis of reference of both samples in variable-intensity mode.
requirements.why: [recall pass] Applies if the rear-lamp stop function is approved as variable-intensity category S2.

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable) used as a single lamp, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 730 cd (7.30∙10^2 cd).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of the maximum intensity over the light distribution field of a single lamp.
requirements.why: [recall pass] Sets the intensity cap for an S2 stop lamp approved as a single lamp.

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable) marked "D", the maximum luminous intensity shall be 365 cd (3.65∙10^2 cd).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of the maximum intensity of the lamp marked "D".
requirements.why: [recall pass] Sets the intensity cap for an S2 stop lamp approved as a "D"-marked lamp.

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility shall be 0.3 cd (3∙10^-1 cd) by day and 0.07 cd (7∙10^-2 cd) by night.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement across the geometric visibility field in both day and night modes.
requirements.why: [recall pass] Sets the minimum intensity within the geometric visibility field for an S2 stop lamp.

requirements.text: Where the type approval of the reversing lamp is granted applying the condition of verification only up to 30° inwards, the device shall only be installed in a pair.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval documentation and vehicle installation drawings to confirm the reversing lamp is fitted only as one of a pair.
requirements.why: [recall pass] This conditional installation restriction applies to the product's reversing lamp function if the pair-only photometric option is used.

requirements.text: In case a lamp (function) uses any other light generating technology (neither incandescent only nor LED only), the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1, ending when photometric stability is reached.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity over time from the Table A8-1 switch-ON point until photometric stability and check it against the minimum and maximum limits.
requirements.why: [recall pass] The light source technology is stated as LED but still to be confirmed, so this conditional run-up compliance obligation may apply to the lamp functions.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2., or for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector drawing and sample for a reserved marking area large enough for the approval marking/UI and the 'TOP' marking.
requirements.why: The rear lamp includes a retro-reflector (Class IA/IB) approved under R150, which must provide marking space.

requirements.text: All markings on the retro-reflector shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the markings and perform a rub/indelibility check.
requirements.why: Applies to all markings carried by the retro-reflective device of the lamp.

requirements.text: The size of the approval marking shall respect the value of 'a' defined in Table 1, i.e. a minimum 'a' of 5 mm for a retro-reflector of Class IA or IB.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval mark dimensions on the sample and confirm 'a' >= 5 mm.
requirements.why: The retro-reflector of the M1 rear lamp is Class IA or IB, for which Table 1 sets 'a' = 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter 'E' followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the circled 'E' with the country number.
requirements.why: Element of the approval marking the retro-reflector must carry when the UI is not used.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the 4-6 digit sequential number.
requirements.why: Element of the approval marking on the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the sample that the sequential number is adjacent to the circled 'E'.
requirements.why: Positional constraint of the approval marking on the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the symbol identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5 (IA or IB for the retro-reflector of a motor vehicle).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the class symbol 'IA' or 'IB'.
requirements.why: The retro-reflector is a Class IA/IB device and must carry its class symbol.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for '150R' followed by the two-digit series (e.g. 150R01).
requirements.why: Element of the approval marking on the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: Where the approval marking is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format shown in Figure I.
requirements.test_case: If a UI is used, compare the marked UI with the Figure I format.
requirements.why: Conditional alternative marking for the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector for the applicant's trade name or mark.
requirements.why: Mandatory marking on the retro-reflector of the lamp.

requirements.text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA or IB, the retro-reflector shall bear the word 'TOP' inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the retro-reflector is rotation-sensitive and, if so, verify 'TOP' is inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.
requirements.why: The retro-reflector is Class IA/IB; the orientation marking applies if rotation is not unambiguous.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraph 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visually confirm legibility of approval mark/UI, trade name and 'TOP' on the retro-reflector.
requirements.why: Location/legibility requirement for markings on the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark with the sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, it shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Install the lamp on a representative vehicle body and check visibility of the single approval mark.
requirements.why: The rear lamp groups the retro-reflector with position, stop and reversing lamps and may use a single mark.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the design to confirm the single mark is on a part that cannot be separated from light-transmitting parts (e.g. outer lens/retro-reflector).
requirements.why: Constraint on mark location when a single mark is used on the grouped rear lamp.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the single approval mark components and compare with the minimum sizes in R150 and R148.
requirements.why: Applies to the combined marking of the grouped rear lamp including the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 and 6 and the referenced Annexes of UN Regulation No. 48 (series of amendments in force at the time of application) pertinent to the retro-reflector and to the vehicle category M1 on which it is intended to be installed shall be applied, where their verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Review the retro-reflector design against the applicable UN R48 installation/device provisions for M1 verifiable at device approval.
requirements.why: The rear lamp incorporates a retro-reflector intended for M1 vehicles, so the pertinent R48 provisions apply.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be so constructed that it functions satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Verify photometric performance before and after environmental/durability tests.
requirements.why: The lamp contains a retro-reflector (P-05), a retro-reflective device.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to its efficient operation or to its maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Inspect samples for design or manufacturing defects affecting performance or maintainability.
requirements.why: Applies to every retro-reflective device including P-05.

requirements.text: The components of the retro-reflector or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector components by hand without tools and confirm they cannot be easily separated.
requirements.why: P-05 is a separate prism element assembled in the lamp and must not be easily dismantled.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall be easy to clean.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the outer surface and perform a cleaning check.
requirements.why: Construction requirement for the retro-reflector's exposed surface.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not be rough.
requirements.test_case: Visual/tactile inspection or roughness measurement of the outer surface.
requirements.why: Surface finish requirement for the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: Any protuberances the outer surface of the retro-reflector may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Inspect protuberances on the outer surface and verify cleaning is not hindered.
requirements.why: Surface geometry requirement for the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflector when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp assembly to confirm the prism (inner) surface of the retro-reflector is enclosed and inaccessible.
requirements.why: P-05 is a retro-reflector placed behind the outer lens; its inner surface must be inaccessible.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, these shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: Check that the optical unit and filter (e.g. red outer lens) cannot be separated under normal use conditions.
requirements.why: The retro-reflector element sits behind the red outer lens, which may act as a filter.

requirements.text: The retro-reflecting optical units and filters of the retro-reflector shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.
requirements.test_case: Inspect materials/process specification to confirm colouring is by tinted material, not paint or varnish.
requirements.why: The red colour of the retro-reflector/lens must be achieved without paint or varnish.

requirements.text: When tested for colour by illumination with CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0°, the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the red retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time red colour of light retro-reflected as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of retro-reflected light under Illuminant A at 1/3° divergence and β1=β2=0° and compare with R48 red limits.
requirements.why: The retro-reflector is red and its night-time colour must comply.

requirements.text: If illumination at β1 = β2 = 0° produces a colourless surface reflection, the colour of the red retro-reflector shall be tested at the angle specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1 (β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°) and the trichromatic coordinates shall be within the R48 night-time red limits.
requirements.test_case: Check for mirror effect at 0°; if present, measure chromaticity at β1=-5°, β2=0°.
requirements.why: Alternative colour test condition for the red retro-reflector when surface reflection occurs.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the retro-reflector shape and dimensions against Annex 5.
requirements.why: The lamp integrates a rear retro-reflector (P-05) of Class IA/IB.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric RI and night-time colour measurement of samples.
requirements.why: Applies to the Class IA/IB retro-reflector in the rear lamp.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.test_case: Run the Table 4 test sequence (heat, water, fuels, oils, corrosion, rear face) on samples.
requirements.why: PMMA moulded-prism retro-reflector must withstand the environmental tests.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and, at least one hour after this test, shall meet the colorimetric characteristics of paragraph 5.1.5. and the RI of paragraph 5.1.4. for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° (or, if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.).
requirements.test_case: 48 h at 65 °C, then colour and RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.why: Heat resistance of the moulded plastic retro-reflector is verified for approval.

requirements.text: The retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum RI values after the heat test shall meet the complete photometric requirements of paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Full photometry of min/max samples at all Table 3 angles.
requirements.why: Full RI compliance of the retro-reflector is required.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Night-time colour measurement after each test group.
requirements.why: Colour of the retro-reflector must be retained after environmental tests.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., verified only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: RI measurement at 20', β1 = β2 = 0° after each test group.
requirements.why: RI of the retro-reflector must be retained after environmental tests.

requirements.text: In the case where more than one or a range of different axes of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric requirements shall be met with reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified.
requirements.test_case: Repeat photometry for each declared axis of reference / extreme axes.
requirements.why: RI compliance of the retro-reflector depends on its declared reference axes.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements of the Class IA or IB retro-reflector, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter shall be considered.
requirements.test_case: Check that the retro-reflective area used for photometry lies within a 200 mm diameter circle.
requirements.why: Constrains the effective retro-reflective area of the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the retro-reflector considered for photometry shall be limited to 100 cm2, though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.
requirements.test_case: Measure/mask the illuminating surface to max 100 cm2 during photometry.
requirements.why: Limits the illuminating surface of the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector shall be equal to or greater than: at an angle of divergence of 20': 300 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 200 mcd/lx at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; 100 mcd/lx at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°; at an angle of divergence of 1°30': 5 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 2.8 mcd/lx at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; 2.5 mcd/lx at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric RI measurement at 20' divergence for the listed illumination angles.
requirements.why: Red Class IA/IB retro-reflector minimum RI values from Table 3. [merged]

requirements.text: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.test_case: Scan RI within the bounded solid angle and compare with the minimum values.
requirements.why: Applies to the RI distribution of the red retro-reflector.

requirements.text: However, where the retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check declared mounting height; limit downward photometry to 5° if below 750 mm.
requirements.why: Rear lamp on M1 may be mounted below 750 mm.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector must be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Spectroradiometric measurement of reflected light chromaticity against R48 red limits.
requirements.why: Rear retro-reflector must reflect red light.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the heat test of 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C followed by visual inspection for distortion, and subsequent colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Oven exposure 48 h at 65 °C, visual inspection, colour and RI check.
requirements.why: Table 4 chronological test sequence for Class IA/IB.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the water test of 10 min in normal position and 10 min in inverted position with visual inspection, followed by colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Immersion test in both positions, visual inspection, colour and RI check.
requirements.why: Table 4 chronological test sequence for Class IA/IB.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the motor fuels test (5 min, visual inspection) and the oils test (5 min, visual inspection), followed by colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Wipe with fuel mixture and lubricating oil, inspect after 5 min, then colour and RI check.
requirements.why: Table 4 chronological test sequence for Class IA/IB.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the corrosion test (24 hours, 2 hours interval, 24 hours, visual inspection) and the rear face test (1 min, visual inspection), followed by colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Salt spray exposure and rear-face test, then visual, colour and RI check.
requirements.why: Table 4 chronological test sequence for Class IA/IB.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of the Class IA or IB retro-reflector shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors of Classes IIIA and IIIB, from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the retro-reflector shape from 10 m.
requirements.why: Shape requirement for the rectangular Class IA/IB retro-reflector.

requirements.text: After the heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection after 48 h at 65 °C.
requirements.why: Pass criterion for heat resistance of the moulded PMMA retro-reflector.

requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit; if visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection after immersion test.
requirements.why: Water-tightness criterion for the retro-reflector, whether part of a lamp or not.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Salt-mist test per ISO 9227 followed by RI and colour check.
requirements.why: Design requirement for corrosion resistance of the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection after salt-mist exposure.
requirements.why: Corrosion pass criterion for the retro-reflector/lamp.

requirements.text: After wiping the outer surface of the retro-reflective device with the n-heptane/toluol test mixture and about five minutes, the surface must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Fuel wipe test and visual inspection after 5 min.
requirements.why: Fuel resistance criterion for the PMMA retro-reflector surface.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5, and an angle of divergence of 20', a retro-reflector not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about its axis of reference to the position of minimum RI, and this minimum RI must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the unmarked retro-reflector through 360° at 20' divergence, find the minimum RI and compare it with the paragraph 5 limit.
requirements.why: Sets a pass/fail criterion: the minimum RI over rotation must meet the specified value.

requirements.text: If the specified values are not attained, the retro-reflector not marked "TOP" may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from the minimum-RI position, and the specified values shall then be met.
requirements.test_case: Where values are missed, re-measure within ±5° of the minimum-RI position and check whether compliance is reached.
requirements.why: Sets the permitted tolerance band within which the retro-reflector must reach the specified RI values.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4, and an angle of divergence of 20', a retro-reflector marked "TOP" shall be rotated about its axis ±5°, and its RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed during this rotation.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the TOP-marked retro-reflector ±5° about its axis at 20' divergence and verify that RI stays at or above the prescribed value throughout.
requirements.why: Sets a pass/fail criterion for retro-reflectors marked TOP.

requirements.text: The moulded plastics retro-reflective device of Class IA or IB shall withstand being kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Condition the retro-reflector sample in a dry oven at 65 °C ± 2 °C for 48 h, then cool for 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.why: The product's retro-reflector is a moulded PMMA Class IA/IB device subject to this heat test.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and withstand immersion for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.test_case: Immerse the stripped retro-reflector (or lamp) for 10 min in 50 °C ± 5 °C water with the top of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the water surface.
requirements.why: The lamp incorporates a retro-reflector (P-05), which must pass this water penetration test.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall withstand a repetition of the 50 °C ± 5 °C immersion test after being turned through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.test_case: Repeat the 10 min 50 °C immersion with the device inverted and the rear face about 20 mm under water.
requirements.why: The second immersion orientation applies to the retro-reflector integrated in the rear lamp.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall then withstand immediate immersion under the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Immediately after the hot-water immersions, immerse the device under the same conditions in 25 °C ± 5 °C water.
requirements.why: The cold-water immersion step completes the water test the retro-reflector must pass.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water, or in case of doubt, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. after the retro-reflective device has first been lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside, and shall satisfy the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Lightly shake the device and measure the RI at 20' divergence and β1 = β2 = 0°, then check it against the paragraph 5.1.4 values.
requirements.why: The retro-reflector must keep its required RI after the water penetration test.

requirements.text: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture test and the dust test of Annex 6 Part 3 shall be applied to the Class IA/IB retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Check the test plan to confirm whether the alternative moisture and dust tests are requested and applied to the retro-reflector.
requirements.why: The rear lamp incorporates a Class IA/IB retro-reflector, so this alternative test route applies to it.

requirements.text: During the water spray test, the precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min, measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform.
requirements.test_case: Measure the precipitation rate with the 100 mm high, ≥140 mm diameter collector before exposing the lamp.
requirements.why: This sets the water exposure severity the lamp's sealing must withstand.

requirements.text: During the water spray test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp before the test to confirm that no drain holes or vents are taped or plugged.
requirements.why: The lamp's venting and drainage design must pass the test in its as-produced open condition.

requirements.text: Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device during the water spray test.
requirements.test_case: Verify that any drain wicks are fitted in the lamp during the spray test.
requirements.why: This is a conditional configuration requirement on the lamp's drainage components.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate) and 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Power the rear position, stop and reversing lamps at design voltage on a 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycle during the spray.
requirements.why: The retro-reflector is grouped with the position, stop and reversing lamps in this rear lamp.

requirements.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.test_case: Log the test duration and verify 12 completed cycles.
requirements.why: This sets the exposure duration the lamp's sealing must endure.

requirements.text: After the spray, the rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
requirements.test_case: Verify a 1 h drain period with the cabinet door closed before evaluation.
requirements.why: This tests the lamp's drainage capability.

requirements.text: No standing pool of water shall be formed in the device, or be capable of being formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Tap and tilt the lamp after draining and check for any pooled water inside.
requirements.why: This is the pass/fail criterion for water ingress into the lamp (seal/gasket).

requirements.text: The test dust used for the dust exposure test shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.
requirements.test_case: Check the dust specification certificate.
requirements.why: This defines the dust exposure the lamp must resist.

requirements.text: During the dust exposure test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the lamp's openings are not sealed before dust exposure.
requirements.why: The lamp's openings must resist dust in their production state.

requirements.text: Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device during the dust exposure test.
requirements.test_case: Verify that any drain wicks are fitted during the dust test.
requirements.why: This is a conditional configuration requirement on the lamp's drainage components.

requirements.text: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours, with the dust allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
requirements.test_case: Log the agitation cycles and total duration of the dust exposure.
requirements.why: This defines the dust exposure severity the lamp must withstand.

requirements.text: The front surface of the retro-reflective device shall resist tarnishing and the protection of its rear face shall resist deterioration, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the front surface and rear face protection of the retro-reflector after the saline mist test.
requirements.why: Applies to the retro-reflector's front surface and rear face (P-05), including any metallised parts.

requirements.text: The lamp with which the retro-reflective device is combined, stripped of all removable parts, shall withstand a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Expose the complete rear lamp, stripped of removable parts, to 2 x 24 h saline mist with a 2 h drying interval.
requirements.why: The retro-reflector is combined with the rear lamp, so the whole lamp is the corrosion test sample.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the device shall withstand a saline mist produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution of 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Run the saline mist test at 35 °C ± 2 °C with 5 % NaCl solution if the device has essential corrodible metal components.
requirements.why: Conditional test condition for the retro-reflector/lamp if metal components (e.g. metallised coating, steel fasteners) are essential.

requirements.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery and cleaning of salt deposits, measure retro-reflection at β2 = 5°, α = 20' and compare to the table limits.
requirements.why: Post-corrosion photometric pass/fail criterion for the retro-reflector (P-05).

requirements.text: The moulded plastics retro-reflective device shall withstand application of a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol.
requirements.test_case: Prepare the 70/30 n-heptane/toluol mixture and apply it to a retro-reflector sample according to Annex 7 Part 1 paragraph 1.1.
requirements.why: The product includes a moulded PMMA retro-reflector that is subject to the fuel resistance test.

requirements.text: For a moulded plastics retro-reflector of Class IA or IB, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall withstand being lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil and then cleaned after about 5 minutes.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the outer and illuminating surfaces with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil, wait about 5 minutes, clean, and inspect the surface.
requirements.why: The product's retro-reflector is a moulded PMMA rear reflector (Class IA/IB), and this oil resistance test applies to it.

requirements.text: After the lubricating oil wipe and cleaning, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and shall satisfy the conditions of paragraph 5.1.4. (at an angle of divergence of 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°, or if necessary in all positions of Annex 4 Part 1, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.).
requirements.test_case: After the oil test, measure the coefficient of luminous intensity at 20' divergence and β1 = β2 = 0°, and compare it with the paragraph 5.1.4 limits.
requirements.why: This is the pass/fail photometric criterion that the moulded plastics retro-reflector must meet after oil exposure.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the test for stability in time of the optical properties (Part 3 of Annex 4), followed by colorimetry (visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates) and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Run the Part 3 of Annex 4 stability test, then check colour and RI at 20' divergence and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.why: [recall pass] This Table 4 row applies to Class IA/IB retro-reflectors and sets a distinct post-ageing pass criterion.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6), followed by colorimetry (visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates) and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Run the Part 6 of Annex 6 weathering test, then measure colour and RI at 20' divergence and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.why: [recall pass] This Table 4 row applies to Class IA/IB retro-reflectors and imposes a distinct weathering durability requirement.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall pass visual inspection against the general specifications (paragraph 4.) before the sequence of tests.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect all ten samples against the general specifications of paragraph 4.
requirements.why: [recall pass] This is the first step of the Table 4 test sequence for Class IA/IB, and every sample must comply.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Vibration test of the mounted lamp, then re-check photometry and aim.
requirements.why: Rear lamp functions are lighting/light-signalling devices fitted to the vehicle.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect fasteners/clips for positive location and verify aim after handling and vibration.
requirements.why: Fasteners hold the rear lamp aim.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the light-signalling device when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed lamp reference axis relative to the road plane.
requirements.why: Rear position, stop, reversing lamps and retro-reflector are light-signalling devices.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the light-signalling device (other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps) shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed reference axis relative to the vehicle median longitudinal plane.
requirements.why: The rear lamp functions are signalling devices other than side devices.

requirements.text: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed for the orientation of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Verify measured axis deviation is within ±3° horizontally and vertically.
requirements.why: Sets the orientation tolerance for the installed rear lamp.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Check installation against the manufacturer's fitting instructions.
requirements.why: Installation of the rear lamp must follow its fitting instructions.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane, based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Measure left and right lamp positions relative to the median plane.
requirements.why: Rear lamps are fitted as a left/right pair.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane (not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp).
requirements.test_case: Compare exterior geometry of left and right lamps.
requirements.why: Rear lamps are fitted as a left/right pair.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of both lamps of the pair.
requirements.why: Left/right rear lamps form a pair.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics.
requirements.test_case: Compare photometric measurements of left and right lamps.
requirements.why: Left/right rear lamps form a pair.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the number and position of logos in rear lamps.
requirements.why: Conditional constraint if the rear lamp incorporates a logo.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect logo content.
requirements.why: Conditional constraint if the rear lamp incorporates a logo.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the pair requirements shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Review symmetry on asymmetrical vehicle body.
requirements.why: Applies to the rear lamp pair if the vehicle body is asymmetrical.

requirements.text: Where lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements shall be fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Verify each function of the grouped rear lamp individually against its requirements.
requirements.why: Rear position, stop and reversing lamps are grouped in one housing.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure each function with all other functions off.
requirements.why: The rear lamp groups several functions.

requirements.text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamp are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the stop lamp with the rear position lamp ON.
requirements.why: Rear position lamp may be reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp.

requirements.text: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps shall not be reciprocally incorporated.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the stop lamp does not share its illuminating surface with a direction indicator.
requirements.why: Constrains the design of the stop lamp.

requirements.text: Single lamps whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts shall be installed such that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the apparent surface, or the minimum distance between facing edges of two adjacent distinct parts does not exceed 75 mm measured perpendicularly to the reference axis (not applicable to a single retro-reflector).
requirements.test_case: Measure projected apparent surface areas or gaps between distinct parts.
requirements.why: LED-array rear lamp functions may have apparent surfaces made of distinct parts.

requirements.text: Where a single lamp is composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro-reflectors, either the projection of their apparent surfaces shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces shall not exceed 75 mm measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure projected apparent surfaces or gap between the two "D" lamps/retro-reflectors.
requirements.why: Conditional if a rear function is realised by two "D" lamps or two retro-reflectors.

requirements.text: Single lamps constituted as an interdependent lamp system shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1; two or more lamps or separate apparent surfaces included in the same lamp body and/or having a common outer lens shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system (except a lamp in the shape of a band or strip).
requirements.test_case: Review lamp system configuration and apparent surface geometry.
requirements.why: Rear lamp has several functions in one body under a common outer lens.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Monitor intensity and colour over time with the lamp ON.
requirements.why: Applies to rear position, stop and reversing lamps.

requirements.text: Where the photometric characteristics of a lamp vary in relation to ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is used to provide another lighting function, any variation shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry in each switching state and compare to limits.
requirements.why: Rear position/stop lamps may vary when other functions are ON.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check visibility of red apparent surface from the front.
requirements.why: Rear position and stop lamps and retro-reflector emit red light at the rear.

requirements.text: There shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Observe from Zone 1 (1 m to 2.2 m height, 15° outward) 25 m in front of the vehicle.
requirements.why: Verification criterion for the red rear lamp functions.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the requirement on red light visibility to the front shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp, taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Measure forward red light intensity of each lamp ≤ 0.25 cd.
requirements.why: Photometric limit for red light emitted forward by the rear lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamps can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps, end-outline marker lamps and side-marker lamps (if they exist) and the rear registration plate lamp.
requirements.test_case: Operate the light switch and verify simultaneous switching.
requirements.why: Rear position lamp electrical connection requirement.

requirements.text: The simultaneous switching requirement does not apply while the front and rear position lamps are switched ON as parking lamps or while daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Verify parking lamp and DRL modes.
requirements.why: Exception for the rear position lamp switching.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Verify simultaneous switching of all interdependent lamps.
requirements.why: Conditional if a rear function is an interdependent lamp system.

requirements.text: The concealment of the rear lamps shall be prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that no concealment device covers the lamps.
requirements.why: Only headlamps and front fog lamps may be concealed.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the reversing lamp.
requirements.why: Product includes a reversing lamp.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the stop lamp.
requirements.why: Product includes a stop lamp.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the rear position lamp.
requirements.why: Product includes a rear position lamp.

requirements.text: The colour of the light of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure colour of the retro-reflected light.
requirements.why: Product includes a rear retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Count installed rear lamp functions.
requirements.why: Number of rear position, stop, reversing lamps and retro-reflectors is regulated.

requirements.text: Where rear position lamps or rear retro-reflectors are installed on movable components, at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check position, visibility and photometry at all fixed positions of the tailgate/boot lid.
requirements.why: Conditional if the rear lamp is mounted on a movable component.

requirements.text: Where additional lamps for rear position or rear retro-reflector functions are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check additional lamps with the movable component open.
requirements.why: Conditional for rear lamps on movable components.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a normal position of use, the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate glare with movable component open.
requirements.why: Conditional if the rear lamp is on a movable component.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the normal position(s) of use, the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Cycle the movable component and verify lamp position.
requirements.why: Conditional if the rear lamp is on a movable component.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of rear position lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component in any fixed position different from the normal position of use.
requirements.test_case: Measure hidden fraction of apparent surface with movable component in fixed open positions.
requirements.why: Applies to the rear position lamp and retro-reflector.

requirements.text: If the 50 per cent requirement is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements shall be switched ON when the apparent surface of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Verify activation and compliance of additional lamps.
requirements.why: Alternative for rear position lamp obscured by movable component.

requirements.text: Where a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is used, the replacement function shall be similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure and measure the replacement function.
requirements.why: Conditional for rear position lamp fail-safe.

requirements.text: Where a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp is used, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: Verify the replacement device's original function during replacement.
requirements.why: Conditional for rear position lamp fail-safe.

requirements.text: During temporary replacement of the rear position lamp function, a tell-tale on the dashboard shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure and check the tell-tale.
requirements.why: Conditional for rear position lamp fail-safe.

requirements.text: Where rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 have variable luminous intensity control and are combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, their intensity shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities through variation conditions.
requirements.why: Conditional if the rear lamp has variable intensity control.

requirements.text: Where rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 have variable luminous intensity control, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps shall be maintained throughout variation transitions in the entire intensity range.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop/position intensity ratio across the range.
requirements.why: Conditional if the rear lamp has variable intensity control.

requirements.text: Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity due to environmental conditions shall be within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations.
requirements.test_case: Verify intensity limits under variable intensity modes.
requirements.why: Conditional for variable intensity rear position/stop lamps.

requirements.text: A decrease of the luminous intensity due to traffic conditions, within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed only as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m; an already activated decrease may remain active as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Test intensity reduction activation vs speed and following distance.
requirements.why: Conditional for variable intensity rear position/stop lamps.

requirements.text: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition of variable luminous intensity.
requirements.test_case: Record intensity during transitions.
requirements.why: Conditional for variable intensity rear position/stop lamps.

requirements.text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which have been tested with a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as approved.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage under constant voltage vehicle condition.
requirements.why: Electrical supply condition for lamp devices.

requirements.text: In all other cases, the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage at the lamp connector.
requirements.why: Electrical supply limit for lamp devices without control gear.

requirements.text: The voltage provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1 and 5.27.2 shall not apply to devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light sources approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the LED PCB includes electronic control gear.
requirements.why: Exception relevant to the LED PCB with drive components.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except obstacles already present when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility angles of the installed lamp for obstructions.
requirements.why: Applies to all rear lamp functions.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface is hidden by further parts of the vehicle, the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles shall still conform to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry of the unobstructed part of the installed lamp.
requirements.why: Applies to rear lamp functions partly hidden by bodywork.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility with all interdependent lamps ON.
requirements.why: Conditional if a rear function is an interdependent lamp system.

requirements.text: All lamps shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify device approval marks on the rear lamp.
requirements.why: Rear position, stop, reversing lamps and retro-reflector require device approval.

requirements.text: In case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check R148 approval for lamps with logo.
requirements.why: Conditional if the rear lamp incorporates a logo.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be present (mandatory) on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle to confirm a reversing lamp is fitted.
requirements.why: The M1 vehicle carrying this rear lamp is a motor vehicle, so the reversing lamp is mandatory.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device is optional.
requirements.test_case: Count the reversing lamps installed on the M1 vehicle (1 or 2).
requirements.why: This sets the permitted number of reversing lamps for M1 vehicles.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check that the reversing lamp carries a valid R23 or R148 approval mark.
requirements.why: The reversing lamp function P-03 must hold component approval.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the reversing lamp's illuminating surface above the ground on the installed vehicle.
requirements.why: This mounting height limit applies to the installed reversing lamp.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation to confirm the reversing lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.why: This is the longitudinal position requirement for the rear-mounted reversing lamp.

requirements.text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility shall be ensured in the vertical direction with α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify the apparent surface is visible over 15° up and 5° down from the reference axis.
requirements.why: This is the vertical visibility field for the rear-mounted reversing lamp.

requirements.text: If there is only one reversing lamp device at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility shall be ensured horizontally with β = 45° to the right and to the left.
requirements.test_case: Verify the apparent surface is visible over 45° left and right of the reference axis.
requirements.why: This applies when the M1 vehicle is fitted with a single reversing lamp.

requirements.text: If there are two reversing lamp devices at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility shall be ensured horizontally with β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify the apparent surface of each lamp is visible over 45° outboard and 30° inboard.
requirements.why: This applies when the optional second reversing lamp is fitted on the M1 vehicle.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the reference axis of the reversing lamp points rearwards.
requirements.why: This is the orientation requirement for the installed reversing lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the reversing lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: confirm the lamp lights only with reverse engaged and the propulsion system in an operable state.
requirements.why: This is the switching logic for the reversing lamp function.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: disengage reverse, or switch off the propulsion system, and confirm the lamp turns OFF or does not turn ON.
requirements.why: This is the switch-off logic for the reversing lamp function.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check R23/R148 for a failure tell-tale requirement and, if one applies, verify the tell-tale operates on lamp failure.
requirements.why: This is a conditional tell-tale obligation for the reversing lamp.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be fitted; they are mandatory on all categories of vehicles, including M1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation to confirm that S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted.
requirements.why: P-02 is an S1/S2 category stop lamp in the rear lamp of an M1 vehicle.

requirements.text: The number of S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices on the vehicle shall be two.
requirements.test_case: Count the S1/S2 stop lamps installed on the vehicle (one per side).
requirements.why: The rear lamp provides one of the two required S1/S2 stop lamps.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking on the stop lamp for UN R7 (02 or later series) or UN R148 approval.
requirements.why: The stop lamp function of P-02 must hold the referenced device approval.

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, the point on the apparent surface of an S1 or S2 category stop lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle and confirm it is ≤ 400 mm.
requirements.why: This sets the lateral position of the S1/S2 stop lamp on an M1 vehicle.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall be positioned above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the stop lamp apparent surface above the ground in the unladen vehicle condition.
requirements.why: This is the mounting height requirement for the S1/S2 stop lamp.

requirements.text: Where an S3 or S4 category device is also fitted, the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of its apparent surface shall be above the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of the S1 or S2 category stop lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure the upper edge of the S1/S2 stop lamp apparent surface and compare it with the lower edge of the S3/S4 lamp apparent surface.
requirements.why: This constrains the vertical position of the S1/S2 stop lamp relative to the high-mounted stop lamp.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation to confirm the stop lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.why: This is the longitudinal position requirement for P-02.

requirements.text: The horizontal angle of geometric visibility of S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify the unobstructed visibility of the apparent surface over ±45° horizontally.
requirements.why: This is the geometric visibility requirement of the S1/S2 stop lamp.

requirements.text: For stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: For lamps with an H-plane height below 750 mm, verify inward visibility of at least 20° below the H plane.
requirements.why: This is an alternative visibility case for a low-mounted S1/S2 stop lamp.

requirements.text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility of S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall be 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Verify the unobstructed visibility of the apparent surface over ±15° vertically.
requirements.why: This is the vertical visibility requirement for P-02.

requirements.text: Where an S1 or S2 category stop lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane), the downward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: For lamps with an H-plane height below 750 mm, verify downward visibility of at least 5°.
requirements.why: This is an alternative vertical visibility case for a low-mounted stop lamp.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation to confirm the reference axis points rearward.
requirements.why: This is the orientation requirement for P-02.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Apply the brake signal and verify that all stop lamps illuminate simultaneously.
requirements.why: This is the electrical connection requirement for the stop lamp function.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamps shall be provided if required by the component regulation; otherwise the tell-tale is optional.
requirements.test_case: Check the component regulation requirements and verify failure tell-tale operation by simulating a stop lamp failure.
requirements.why: An LED stop lamp may require failure indication under its component regulation.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps (devices of R or R1 or R2 categories) shall be mandatory on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for the presence of rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2.
requirements.why: The product provides the mandatory rear position lamp function for M1 vehicles.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two.
requirements.test_case: Count the rear position lamps installed on the vehicle.
requirements.why: Sets the installed quantity of the product's rear position lamp function.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking on the lamp for an R7 (02 or later) or R148 approval.
requirements.why: The lamp must hold a component approval to be installed.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge.
requirements.why: Constrains the lamp design and mounting position on the vehicle.

requirements.text: In height, the rear position lamp shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the apparent surface above the ground in unladen condition.
requirements.why: Constrains the mounting height of the lamp.

requirements.text: If the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed, the maximum height of the rear position lamp above the ground may be 2,100 mm.
requirements.test_case: Verify bodywork justification and measure that the height does not exceed 2,100 mm.
requirements.why: Alternative height limit applicable to the lamp's mounting.

requirements.text: In length, the rear position lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle to confirm the lamp is fitted at the rear.
requirements.why: Defines the longitudinal mounting location of the product.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be, in the horizontal plane, 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of the apparent surface over 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
requirements.why: Constrains lamp optics and housing/outer lens design and installation.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height from the H plane and verify inward visibility of at least 20° under the H plane.
requirements.why: Conditional visibility requirement for low-mounted lamps.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be, in the vertical plane, 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of the apparent surface over 15° up and 15° down.
requirements.why: Constrains lamp optics and installation.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height from the H plane and verify downward visibility of at least 5°.
requirements.why: Conditional vertical visibility requirement for low-mounted lamps.

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 45° outwards to 45° inwards.
requirements.test_case: Confirm a rear side-marker lamp is installed and verify visibility 45° outwards to 45° inwards.
requirements.why: Alternative visibility option for M1 vehicles applicable to the product.

requirements.text: Under the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height and verify inward visibility of at least 20° under the H plane.
requirements.why: Conditional reduction within the M1 alternative visibility option.

requirements.text: Under the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., the vertical angle of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility over 15° up and down.
requirements.why: Vertical visibility under the M1 alternative option.

requirements.text: Under the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height and verify downward visibility of at least 5°.
requirements.why: Conditional vertical reduction within the M1 alternative option.

requirements.text: To be considered visible under the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.
requirements.test_case: Measure the unobstructed projected apparent surface at the boundary angles and confirm at least 12.5 cm².
requirements.why: Pass criterion for visibility of the lamp under the alternative option.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded when assessing the visible apparent surface of the rear position lamp.
requirements.test_case: Exclude the non-light-transmitting retro-reflector area when computing the 12.5 cm² visible surface.
requirements.why: The product incorporates a retro-reflector adjacent to the position lamp.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the lamp reference axis points rearwards.
requirements.why: Defines the orientation of the installed lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11., such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps if they exist, the side-marker lamps if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Operate the position lamp switch and verify simultaneous switching of all listed lamps.
requirements.why: Constrains the electrical connection of the product's rear position lamp.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Switch on the position lamps and verify the closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates.
requirements.why: Installation requirement linked to the product's rear position lamp function.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp tell-tale shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Verify a single tell-tale indicates both front and rear position lamps.
requirements.why: Tell-tale configuration requirement for the function.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale requirement shall not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: With DRL switched ON, verify tell-tale behaviour is not subject to the closed-circuit requirement.
requirements.why: Exception condition to the tell-tale obligation.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp shall be mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check component Regulation (R7/R148) requirements and, if applicable, simulate a lamp failure and verify the failure tell-tale activates.
requirements.why: Conditional failure tell-tale obligation tied to the lamp's component approval.

requirements.text: The rear non-triangular retro-reflector shall be fitted (mandatory) on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle rear for presence of rear retro-reflectors.
requirements.why: The product provides the rear retro-reflector function for an M1 motor vehicle.

requirements.text: The number of rear non-triangular retro-reflectors shall be two.
requirements.test_case: Count the rear retro-reflectors installed on the vehicle.
requirements.why: The installation number applies to the retro-reflector integrated in the rear lamp.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking on the retro-reflector for Class IA/IB under R3 02+ or R150 00+.
requirements.why: The retro-reflector must carry the corresponding device approval.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Verify by inspection that any additional retro-reflecting devices do not impair mandatory lamp effectiveness.
requirements.why: Conditional obligation if additional retro-reflecting elements are provided in the lamp.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the illuminating surface of the retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost illuminating surface point to the vehicle's extreme outer edge.
requirements.why: Lateral position constraint for the retro-reflector on the vehicle.

requirements.text: In height, the retro-reflector shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the illuminating surface above ground in unladen condition.
requirements.why: Mounting height constraint for the retro-reflector grouped in the rear lamp.

requirements.text: In length, the retro-reflector shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation position on the vehicle rear.
requirements.why: Longitudinal position constraint for the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 30° inwards and outwards.
