requirements.test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of the illuminating surface over 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.why: Geometric visibility constrains lamp/housing design and installation.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and below horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of the illuminating surface over 10° above and below horizontal.
requirements.why: Geometric visibility constrains lamp/housing design and installation.

requirements.text: However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height from the H plane; if below 750 mm verify downward visibility of at least 5°.
requirements.why: Exception affecting the visibility requirement depending on mounting height.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the reference axis of the retro-reflector points rearwards.
requirements.why: Orientation constraint for the installed retro-reflector.

requirements.text: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5. and 6. (the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector as installed shall continue to meet the installation requirements in series production).
requirements.test_case: Conformity-of-production audit of production vehicles checking installed rear lamp functions against paragraphs 5 and 6.
requirements.why: The rear lamp installed on the M1 vehicle must remain compliant in series production for the vehicle to conform to the approved type.

requirements.text: The position of the lamps in width, in height and in length shall be such that the measured distances fulfil the individual specifications applicable to each lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector).
requirements.test_case: Measure width, height and length position of each rear lamp function on production vehicles and compare with paragraph 6 limits.
requirements.why: The lamp geometry and mounting points determine the installed position checked at conformity of production.

requirements.text: The measured angles of geometric visibility shall fulfil the individual specifications applicable to each lamp, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3° variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility angles of each rear lamp function on production vehicles per paragraph 2.10.7 with ±3° allowance.
requirements.why: The housing, lens and reflector design must provide the required visibility angles of the rear lamp functions within CoP tolerance.

requirements.text: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be such that the requirements of paragraph 5.10. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Visually check on production vehicle that no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front and white light to the rear is limited to the reversing lamp.
requirements.why: The rear lamp emits red light and white reversing light whose visibility is checked at CoP.

requirements.text: When every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle is switched on, the lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.test_case: Switch on rear position, stop and reversing functions on production vehicles and verify correct operation and switching.
requirements.why: The lamp's electrical connections and functions are checked for correct operation at CoP.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the lamps shall be such that the requirements of paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. and the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of rear lamps and their markings on production vehicles for presence, number, colour (red/white) and arrangement.
requirements.why: The rear lamp's colours, arrangement and markings are verified by visual inspection at CoP.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector function on movable components is obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D", only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable components.
requirements.test_case: Measure position, visibility and photometry of the designated "D" lamp at all fixed positions of the movable component.
requirements.why: [recall pass] This conditional installation rule applies to the rear position lamp and retro-reflector when they are split across a movable component.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp function is obtained by an interdependent lamp system mounted completely on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1 shall be satisfied, and any additional lamps switched ON in a fixed open position shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Verify photometry, colour and visibility of the interdependent system and of any additional lamps at all fixed positions.
requirements.why: [recall pass] This conditional rule applies to the rear position lamp when it is realised as an interdependent system on a movable component.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp interdependent lamp system is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s), and the inwards geometric visibility requirement is deemed satisfied if they still conform to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution.
requirements.test_case: Measure the specified interdependent lamp at all fixed positions of the movable component.
requirements.why: [recall pass] This conditional rule applies to the rear position lamp installed across fixed and movable components.

requirements.text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.test_case: Verify that each lamp function operates with only light source/fuse installation and no additional modification.
requirements.why: [recall pass] Each lamp function of the product must be operable in this way to count as fitted.

requirements.text: Where two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip are used, they shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extend on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, be not less than 0.8 m long, and be illuminated by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends.
requirements.test_case: Measure strip length, lateral extent and light source positions on the vehicle.
requirements.why: [recall pass] This conditional design and installation rule applies if the rear lamp is executed as a band/strip interdependent system.

requirements.text: Where the stop lamps are used as the emergency stop signal, the emergency stop signal shall be a flashing lamp.
requirements.test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal and verify that the stop lamps flash.
requirements.why: [recall pass] This conditional obligation applies to the stop lamp function if it provides the emergency stop signal.
